propositions: A one-time backfill script draws retroactive caused_by links over existing closed bugs using the conservative blame->commit->ticket single-culprit resolver.
The script reuses the same conservative single-culprit resolver as live auto-derivation so backfilled links are deterministic and consistent with going-forward ones.
Idempotency is achieved by an explicit _is_active_link check before writing, since _write_link_event has no built-in idempotency and bypasses add_dependency's closed-source guard.
The script defaults to --dry-run to preview before writing; running in write mode twice draws the link on the first pass and zero new links on the second.
Over a fixture of two closed bugs (one single-culprit, one ambiguous), the script links exactly one caused_by to the single-culprit's resolved ticket and skips the ambiguous bug.
Tests live in the scripts tier with external tools stubbed so the run is deterministic without scc/lizard/jscpd installed.
